svg.title: Graph abuse cluster lifecycle sequence
svg.desc: The CLI validates an opaque fixture, verifies Neo4j connectivity, atomically seeds and reads a bounded graph through graph/neo4j, analyzes clusters in Go, closes resources, and only then writes buffered JSON.
svg.text: Time flows downward. One atomic seed and two bounded reads precede cleanup and stdout.
NEO4J: VERIFY, ATOMIC SEED, TWO BOUNDED READS
alt backend failure or cancellation: redact, clean up, emit no partial JSON
The CLI rejects non-loopback Bolt URIs before it creates the caller-owned driver.
The max+1 reads turn oversize data into a typed error instead of silent truncation.
No report bytes reach stdout until client and driver cleanup succeeds.
Opaque identifiers and provider details never appear in terminal errors.
Neo4j supplies storage; graph/neo4j supplies adapter I/O; the example owns every cluster decision.
